# Lisbon 4-Day Trip Plan for 2 Adults

A walkable, transit-friendly Lisbon itinerary focused on museums, scenic neighborhoods, and affordable seafood. Costs below are estimated for **2 adults** and stay within your **€1,200 total budget excluding flights**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and Alfama First Impressions
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive and settle in near Baixa/Chiado for easy walking access.
- Afternoon: Explore **Praça do Comércio**, **Rua Augusta**, and the **Santa Justa area**; continue into **Chiado** for cafés and bookshops.
- Evening: Wander **Alfama** at sunset, then have an affordable seafood dinner near the old town.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4c/Lisbon_%281600%29_detail_1.jpg Alt=Evening: Wander **Alfama** at sunset, then have an affordable seafood dinner near the old town, Lisbon, Portugal
- Estimated cost: **€170**
  - Transit: €10
  - Food & drinks: €80
  - Sightseeing/snacks: €20
  - Lodging share: €60

### Day 2: Museums and Belém by Tram
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit the **National Museum of Ancient Art** or **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** for a strong cultural start.
- Afternoon: Take public transit to **Belém**; see the **Jerónimos Monastery** area, **Belém Tower** exterior, and riverside promenade.
- Evening: Return to the city for dinner in **Cais do Sodré** or **Bairro Alto** with a seafood-forward, budget-conscious meal.
- Estimated cost: **€205**
  - Transit: €12
  - Museum entries: €35
  - Food & drinks: €88
  - Lodging share: €70

### Day 3: Scenic Neighborhoods and Tram Routes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- Morning: Ride or walk through **Graça** and **Mouraria** for viewpoints and classic Lisbon street scenes.
- Afternoon: Spend time at **Miradouro da Senhora do Monte** and nearby lanes; pause for a relaxed lunch in a local tascas-style spot.
- Evening: Cross to **Príncipe Real** for a low-key dinner, then enjoy a slow walk back through central Lisbon.
- Estimated cost: **€180**
  - Transit: €10
  - Food & drinks: €90
  - Sightseeing/snacks: €20
  - Lodging share: €60

### Day 4: Modern Lisbon and Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Visit **MAAT** or the **Gulbenkian Museum** depending on your interest in modern art versus classic collections.
- Afternoon: Use the remaining time for a final neighborhood stroll in **Parque das Nações** or a relaxed café lunch.
- Evening: Head to the airport or enjoy one last early seafood dinner if your flight is later.
- Estimated cost: **€165**
  - Transit: €12
  - Museum entries: €25
  - Food & drinks: €68
  - Lodging share: €60

## Budget Snapshot

| Category | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Lodging | €250–€320 |
| Food & drinks | €320–€380 |
| Museums & entry fees | €70–€120 |
| Transit | €40–€60 |
| Snacks/cafés/misc. | €60–€90 |
| Total estimated trip spend | **€740–€970** |

## Simple Packing Checklist

- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light jacket or wind layer
- Compact umbrella or rain shell
- Crossbody day bag or small backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Portable charger
- Travel adapter if needed
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Light layers for cool evenings
- Copies of IDs, cards, and booking details

## Quick Actions
